newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica Financial says deal worth $814 mln.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica Financial says deal worth $814 mln.

text.p: Allmerica Financial Corp said Thursday the value of its pending merger with Allmerica Property & Casualty Cos Inc is $814 million.
Allmerica Financial said the figure is based on an average closing price of $40.125 for its stock during the 10 trading days between June 25 and July 9, used to determine consideration in the deal.

Allmerica Financial is buying the 40.5 percent of Allmerica P&C that it does not already own, in exchange for a combination of cash and Allmerica Financial stock. The deal is scheduled to close July 16.
Following completion of the merger, Allmerica P&C shareholders will receive the right to exchange each share of Allmerica P&C for $17.60 cash and 0.40 share of Allmerica Financial.
Alternatively, Allmerica P&C shareholders may elect to receive $33 cash or 0.85714 share of Allmerica Financial.
Allmerica Financial said it expects the election deadline to be August 13, after which merger consideration will be distributed as soon as possible.

About 9.67 million shares of Allmerica Financial, with an aggregate value of $388 million based on the average closing price, and $426 million cash will be payable to Allmerica P&C shareholders in the transaction, the company said.
